name: Raspberry Red
lede: Raspberry red is the red or purplish red of the fruit, a dictionary color word that sits between plain red and crimson.

sections.title: The fruit's color
sections.body:
Paterson defines raspberry as the red or purplish red of the raspberry, and records raspberry-red and crushed raspberry as variants [1]. Pastoureau, discussing the colors of modern medicines, notes that a fruit-flavored red-pink can evoke strawberry, raspberry or red currant, which helps children take liquid medicine [2].

The books say little more, so the history of the name is undocumented here, and it sits close to [[crimson]] and [[red]].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Raspberry red is rare in painting. In our archive of 23,781 paintings, a color within six units of this swatch covers a twentieth of the canvas in only 3 works, among them Matisse's *Nude with a White Scarf* of 1909 and Kirchner's *Two Girls under an Umbrella* of 1910 [3]. As always these are photographs of varnished paintings, so read them as screen colors [3].

origin.source: Paterson, A Dictionary of Colour, p. 332
